verdicts.reason: A: the three fare cards are shrunk to tiny scattered tiles with unreadable city names and 'from' labels, the logo is wedged between two cards, and the body copy is pushed off to the side of the CTA, but the card order and the headline-then-CTA flow survive. B is worse: the CTA sits at the top above everything, the cards are out of order (Reykjavik, Lisbon, Marrakech) and just as tiny, and the body copy appears above the headline it supports, so the reading order is jumbled and the layout doesn't read as designed.
